summary: Iteration 20 — Ownership Model + Studio AI + Tier Locking. Backend 17/17 pytest tests PASS (100%): /api/ownership/products returns 2 AUD products (ownership_full $79.98 + ownership_finance $9.99 × 12), /api/ownership/{user_id}/status returns status=none for new users, /api/ownership/simulate with ownership_full marks owned, /api/ownership/simulate with ownership_finance × 12 progresses financing→owned (verified payment counter at each step), invalid tier_key returns 400, /api/subscriptions/tiers?user_id=X returns is_owned + per-tier `locked` (student/family/adult_band/under18_band/couple_duo all locked for non-owner, all unlocked after ownership_full sim), /api/subscriptions/select for student WITHOUT ownership returns 403 with detail containing 'Creator Ecosystem', /api/subscriptions/select for student AFTER ownership succeeds, /api/payments/checkout for ownership_full creates Stripe URL with AUD currency, /api/payments/checkout for student WITHOUT ownership returns 403, /api/payments/checkout for listener always returns 200 (USD), /api/studio/genres returns exactly the 4 whitelisted genres (mtv_classic, ministry_of_sound, hip_hop_top200, alt_rock), /api/studio/beat/generate with valid genre/bpm/bars returns kick/snare/hihat/bass arrays of len bars*4 + duration_sec, invalid genre returns 400, /api/studio/cleanup with mode=rock,live=true returns status='applied' + profile params, mode=invalid returns 400. Frontend Pricing page fully validated end-to-end: pricing-page mounts via ?payment=cancelled URL param (App.js iteration-19 fix confirmed working), ownership-hero renders with headline 'Unlock the Creator Ecosystem', both ownership-full-checkout-btn and ownership-finance-checkout-btn visible, all 5 locked-tier overlays present (tier-locked-student, tier-locked-family, tier-locked-adult_band, tier-locked-under18_band, tier-locked-couple_duo), clicking ownership-full-sim-btn triggers POST /api/ownership/simulate, toast 'Creator Ecosystem unlocked! All tiers available.' appears, ownership-status-owned badge ('OWNER') renders, ALL 5 lock overlays disappear after sim (verified count=0 remaining). Neon orange (#FF6B00) + neon green (#39FF14) theme applied correctly on hero and badges.

not_validated.reason: PlayerStudio entry view is the 'What do you want to remix?' search/upload screen — BeatMaker component is only rendered AFTER a track is loaded or 'Start Original' flow is initiated. The component file exists and the data-testid is correct per file inspection, but it was not reachable in a quick UI smoke pass. Main agent should verify by deeply navigating: Studio tab → Start Original (or load a song) → expect BeatMaker visible.

Clicking the bottom-nav 'Record' tab did not mount [data-testid='recording-studio'] in this smoke pass — likely the Record tab requires a layout selection or pre-step before the stadium layout (which holds avatar-ring-* and live-cleanup-toggle) renders. Code inspection confirms the data-testids exist at lines 140/167/215/231 of RecordingStudio.js. Main agent should verify by walking the full Record flow.

action_items: VERIFY (main agent self-test): Navigate to Studio tab → trigger 'Start Original' or load a track → confirm [data-testid='beat-maker'] is visible with genre chips, BPM slider, bars buttons, key buttons, generate button. The component file exists and was not validated in UI smoke only because PlayerStudio's default landing is a search screen.

VERIFY (main agent self-test): Navigate to Record tab → pick a layout (e.g. layout-stadium) → confirm [data-testid='recording-studio'], [data-testid='live-cleanup-toggle'] and [data-testid^='avatar-ring-'] all render. Then toggle live-cleanup-toggle and confirm POST /api/studio/cleanup fires (returns 200 with profile params per backend tests).
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py: _credit_ownership correctly distinguishes one_time vs finance path; finance path tracks prior_made/prior_total only when prior method==finance, preventing accidental promotion if user pays full after partial finance. Good.
payments.py: /payments/checkout has correct 403 gate for LOCKED_TIERS — verified via test_checkout_student_no_ownership_403.

platform.py: LOCKED_TIERS is derived from `requires_ownership` flag on SUBSCRIPTION_TIERS (single source of truth), but DUPLICATED in payments.py as a hardcoded set. Recommendation: import LOCKED_TIERS from platform into payments to keep them in sync — if a new locked tier is added, devs must update both files today.

studio_ai.py: beat generation is deterministic (seed = hash of genre/bpm/bars/key) so the same params return the same pattern — this is a real property worth flagging to product (cache vs creativity trade-off). For a mock it's fine; when real AudioCraft/Suno is wired this seed approach should be removed.
studio_ai.py: cleanup_jobs / beats collections have no TTL or pruning. For a production rollout, add a 30-day TTL index on cleanup_jobs.created_at and beats.created_at.

OWNERSHIP_FINANCE_TOTAL_PAYMENTS=12 with $9.99 = $119.88 AUD vs one-time $79.98 AUD = $39.90 markup (~50% finance premium). Confirm with product that this differential is intended (it's significant for the 'Subscribe to Own' messaging).
PricingPage successfully separates listener (USD) vs ownership products (AUD) visually — confirmed in screenshot — currency labels are correct ($79.98 AUD and $9.99/mo × 12 with Total $119.88 AUD).

success_rate.frontend: 100% on Pricing page (ownership hero, both CTAs, all 5 lock overlays, sim button → unlock toast + OWNER badge + lock overlays cleared). BeatMaker + RecordingStudio data-testids exist in source per code inspection but were not reached via the quick nav smoke (each requires a multi-step deeper flow).

test_credentials: None — anonymous app. Test user_ids prefixed TEST_iter20_*. Frontend localStorage key: sidetrack_voter_id.

Frontend pricing fully verified by visiting `${REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL}/?payment=cancelled` (App.js routes to PricingPage on URL params, iteration-19 fix). To re-test BeatMaker + RecordingStudio properly: (a) set localStorage.sidetrack_voter_id, (b) click bottom nav Studio (or Record), (c) walk the full flow (Start Original / pick layout), (d) then assert data-testids. Backend POST /api/studio/beat/generate + /api/studio/cleanup return correctly mocked deterministic payloads.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All iteration-20 backend acceptance criteria pass; pricing UI integration verified live; deeper UI components (BeatMaker, RecordingStudio internals) require multi-step navigation not covered in smoke. Main agent should self-test these two surfaces or invoke another testing iteration with explicit step-by-step UI navigation instructions.
